faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the BRIC National Agri Food and Biomanufacturing Institute (BRIC NABI), located in Mohali, Punjab, for filling up administrative and research support positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name advertised in this notification is Management Assistant under the research and administrative wing of the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Management Assistant post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline with required government service experience, or an MBA with 2 years of experience in reputed firms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Management Assistant post will receive a salary in Level-6, ranging from ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 26-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for BRIC NABI Management Assistant Recruitment 2026 is strictly online through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of BRIC NABI?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website at www.nabi.res.in to access the application portal and official notifications.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee details are specified in the notification, meaning candidates should check the official portal for any applicable processing charges.
